a5.lr_floor.text: It shines! I can see my face in it.

a5.lr_window.text: On a clear day you can see all the way to the mountains.

a5.lr_curtain.text: Ooh, fancy! Are you expecting guests?

a5.frames.text: That's your Hajurba, the day he opened the shop.

a5.clock.text: Now I know it's not dinner time. Again.

a5.bookshelf.text: My books, Hajurama's recipes and Bhai's comics. Perfect.

a5.lr_lamp.text: Another light, another success for Kanchha Dai!

a5.tea_table.text: A tea table! I'll bring the tea.

a5.plant.text: It needs water twice a week. Bhai, that's your job.

a5.arrive.text: This is MY room. Well, everyone's room. But mostly mine.
Bhai... why is there a sock on the ceiling fan?

a5.outro.text: The family room feels like a family room again.
Can we go on the roof now? I want to fly my kite!
Roof it is. Bring the kite, Bhai!
